daily.today_energy: Mars and Jupiter are both in your sign right now, amplifying your natural confidence and drive. The Sun's square to both planets means that intensity needs direction—channel that fire into something that actually matters to you, not just immediate wins.
daily.love: Venus is playing nice with Jupiter today, softening edges and making you more magnetic than usual. If you've been holding back on vulnerability, this is a good moment. Your Leo warmth is irresistible right now, but make sure you're not just performing.
daily.career: That Mars-Jupiter combo in Leo is basically giving you superpowers for action and ambition. The Sun squaring both suggests you might feel pulled in multiple directions—pick one priority and go hard on it. This isn't the day to scatter your energy.
daily.health: With Mars firing you up, movement feels good today. Channel that restless energy into exercise or something physical that actually excites you. Saturn retrograde reminds you that rest isn't laziness—balance the hustle with recovery.

weekly.overview: Mars and Jupiter are both in your sign this week, amplifying your natural magnetism and drive—but watch out for overconfidence when the Sun squares both planets early week. The Full Moon in Gemini (Nov 24) lights up your communication sector, making it the perfect moment to speak up about what matters. Best Day: Nov 24. Watch-Out Day: Nov 20.
weekly.love: With Venus in Libra sextile Jupiter, romantic energy flows smoothly if you're willing to be vulnerable. Early week might feel pushy or intense, but by midweek the vibe shifts to something genuinely connective. Single? The Full Moon wants you to actually *talk* about your feelings instead of just projecting confidence.
weekly.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo is your power move, but the Sun squaring both planets means your ambition might overshadow teamwork early on. Midweek, dial back the dominance—your best professional wins come through collaboration, not conquest. The Gemini Full Moon rewards clear communication and strategic networking.
weekly.health: Your energy levels are through the roof with Mars and Jupiter in Leo, but that's exactly why you need to actually rest. High vibes don't mean you're invincible. The Moon trine Mars midweek is perfect for intense workouts; the Full Moon asks you to balance that fire with something grounding like stretching or meditation.
